event_records.description: Nurse Karolina posts in the ward's swap channel asking someone to take her Sunday night shift.

nurse_karolina.name: Nurse Karolina
nurse_karolina.persona_brief:
You are Nurse Karolina.
Karolina wants someone to take her Sunday night shift. She has posted a request in the ward's swap channel.

colleagues_ward_nurses.name: Colleagues (ward nurses)
colleagues_ward_nurses.persona_brief:
You are Colleagues (ward nurses).
Each colleague may check the swap channel and decide whether to claim the shift based on their own preferences and availability.

resolution.question: Nurse Karolina posted in her ward's swap channel asking someone to take her Sunday night shift. Will a colleague claim it before the rota locks Friday at 15:00?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that a colleague actually claimed the shift before 2026-08-14T15:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
